leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply inline styles to HTML elements by directly assigning style objects to the style attribute in JSX.
Use TypeScript interfaces to define type-safe style objects with specific CSS property types.
Implement dynamic styling by controlling style objects through React state variables.
Execute conditional rendering logic to apply different style objects based on component state.
Utilize the React.CSSProperties type to ensure type safety for all style objects.
Construct reusable style objects as constants to maintain consistency across components.
Control component appearance by modifying style object properties through event handlers.
Define event handler functions to update state variables that drive dynamic inline styles.
Access and modify nested style properties within style objects using dot notation.
Compare inline styling approaches with CSS classes to understand their respective use cases.
Modify multiple CSS properties simultaneously by updating entire style objects.
Return JSX elements with inline styles that respond to user interactions and state changes.
